steps.script: SELECT COALESCE(MEASURE(count), 0) c FROM orders WHERE created_at >= $1::timestamp AND created_at < $2::timestamp \bind '2025-05-10 00:00:00' '2025-05-21 00:00:00' \g
SELECT COALESCE(MEASURE(count), 0) c FROM orders WHERE created_at >= $1 AND created_at < $2 \bind '2025-05-10 00:00:00' '2025-05-21 00:00:00' \g
SELECT MEASURE(count) c FROM orders WHERE created_at >= $1 AND created_at < $2 \bind '2025-05-10 00:00:00' '2025-05-21 00:00:00' \g
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) c FROM orders WHERE created_at >= $1 AND created_at < $2 \bind '2025-05-10 00:00:00' '2025-05-21 00:00:00' \g
